gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Commanding and uniform in line, Unica One puts a display voice up front with open curves. Noto Sans Hanunoo does its best work lower down, with tall small letters and open terminals.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Commanding and distinctive, Unica One draws every stroke as a steady outline. Noto Sans Hebrew sits beneath it, a sans with a dominant midsection and wide gaps between curve ends and stems.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-imperial-a: Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic keeps its c open like a pair of pincers. Unica One excels up top, its strokes never changing thickness, while the sans below handles text with a short step from lowercase to capital.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-inscriptio: Commanding lines up top, wide-eyed letters waiting below. Unica One does commanding display lines, while Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian does text, with big open eyes and a deep middle band.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Unica One shows no stroke contrast whatsoever, with light showing inside every curve. And Noto Sans Khudawadi, with unsealed rounds and capitals barely taller than its lowercase, would make extended text feel clean and approachable.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Commanding display curves, never pinched, with daylight inside. Unica One leads, then Noto Sans Limbu, a plain sans with tall-bodied small letters and gaping curves, makes extended reading feel open and approachable.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Unica One is a rope-thin outline with no thick or thin parts. Noto Sans Lisu, a plain sans with wide-open s curves and ascenders hugging the x-height, gives that display line a steady partner underneath.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Flat, unshaded strokes up top, with generous openings waiting down below. Unica One is best at commanding display lines, while Noto Sans Malayalam, a plain sans, is best at text with a dominant middle zone.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Unica One draws letters as if with a marker tip, commanding and light-filled in every curve. Noto Sans Marchen takes over below as a plain sans, its small letters standing almost capital-sized.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-mayan-nume: Unica One reads like outlines drawn in a single width, commanding and distinctive. Noto Sans Mayan Numerals brings the pair's real strength: tall-bodied small letters and a visibly gaping c at any size.
